drills.name: Shadow turn and point
drills.steps: Stand side-on to a mirror or wall. Turn your shoulders until your non-racket hand points at the side fence. Hold 2 s, return. 3 sets of 10.
drills.goal: Chest faces the side fence on 8 of 10 turns.

drills.name: Drop-feed turn and hit
drills.steps: Partner drop-feeds a bounce from the service line. Turn early (before the bounce), hit crosscourt. 3 sets of 8.
drills.goal: Shoulders turned before the ball bounces on 6 of 8 balls.

drills.name: Turn on the move
drills.steps: Partner feeds alternate sides; recover to the middle and turn each time. 4 sets of 6.
drills.goal: Visible shoulder turn on every ball.

drills.name: Shadow swing past a marker
drills.steps: Put a cone or water bottle ~1 racket length in front of your front hip. Swing and brush it with the strings at contact. 3 sets of 10.
drills.goal: Strings pass the marker at the same point on 8 of 10 swings.

drills.name: Self-drop forehands to a hoop
drills.steps: Drop the ball in front of your front hip, hit it into the cross-court service box. 3 sets of 8.
drills.goal: Ball contacted in front of the hip on 6 of 8.

drills.name: Fed forehands, call 'now'
drills.steps: Partner feeds; say 'now' out loud at contact and have the partner judge if it was in front. 4 sets of 6.
drills.goal: Partner agrees contact was in front on 4 of 6.

drills.name: Finish and freeze
drills.steps: Slow-motion forehand swings. Finish with the racket over the opposite shoulder and freeze 2 s. 3 sets of 10.
drills.goal: Held finish above shoulder height on 8 of 10.

drills.name: Over-the-net-by-a-metre rally
drills.steps: Hit ten forehands (self-feed) aiming ~1 m above the net, over a rope or line. 3 sets.
drills.goal: 7 of 10 balls clear the target height and land in.

drills.name: Finish-high rally
drills.steps: Cooperative cross-court rally, finish over the shoulder every shot. 5 min x 2.
drills.goal: Rally of 6+ shots with a full finish.

drills.name: Arm-length spacing check
drills.steps: Extend the racket arm out to the side, then relax the elbow slightly. Swing slowly keeping that spacing. 3 sets of 10.
drills.goal: Same relaxed arm shape at contact on 8 of 10.

drills.name: Wall or fence spacing
drills.steps: Stand a racket-length plus an arm from a fence; swing so the racket brushes without jamming. 3 sets of 8.

drills.name: Fed balls at varied depth
drills.steps: Partner varies depth; adjust your feet so contact is at comfortable arm's length. 4 sets of 6.

drills.name: Sit and swing
drills.steps: Stand with feet shoulder width. Bend knees ~20 degrees, shadow swing while staying low, rise through contact. 3 sets of 10.
drills.goal: Stay bent until contact on 8 of 10.

drills.name: Split-step and hit
drills.steps: Self-feed, split-step as the ball bounces, hit. 3 sets of 8.
drills.goal: Balanced, knees bent at contact on 6 of 8.

drills.name: Low-ball focus
drills.steps: Partner feeds low balls; bend legs to get under the ball. 4 sets of 6.
drills.goal: Stable, not bending at the waist, on 4 of 6.

drills.name: Head-still shadow swing
drills.steps: Place a small sticker on a mirror at head height; keep your eyes on it while swinging. 3 sets of 10.
drills.goal: Head stays on the sticker on 8 of 10 swings.

drills.name: Balanced finish hold
drills.steps: Self-feed forehands and hold your finish for 2 s without stepping. 3 sets of 8.

drills.name: Fed balls, upright posture
drills.steps: Partner feeds wider balls; step to the ball, keep upright on contact. 4 sets of 6.

turn.title: Limited shoulder rotation
turn.summary: Your shoulders barely rotate through the swing, so the arm has to do all the work.
turn.cue: Turn so your non-racket hand points at the side fence, then let the racket sweep through the ball toward the target.

contact.title: Contact too close to / behind the body
contact.summary: You meet the ball beside or behind your hip rather than out in front, which makes the shot late and inconsistent.
contact.cue: Meet the ball out in front, about a racket's length ahead of your front hip.

follow.title: Short follow-through
follow.summary: The swing stops soon after contact instead of finishing across and up.
follow.cue: Send the ball over the net by a metre or more and let your racket finish over your opposite shoulder.

elbow.title: Arm cramped or locked at contact
elbow.summary: Your hitting arm is either jammed in tight or fully locked straight at contact.
elbow.cue: Give the ball room: contact it with a relaxed, slightly bent arm at a comfortable arm's length.

knee.title: Not enough knee bend
knee.summary: You stay tall through the swing, which limits balance and the ability to adjust to ball height.
knee.cue: Sit slightly into your legs so you can push up through the ball.

lean.title: Excess trunk lean
lean.summary: Your upper body tips noticeably away from vertical at contact, which hurts balance and consistency.
lean.cue: Keep your head still and over your base while the racket swings past it.
